gallop.description: Clean looping gallop cycle for server-tick horizontal movement.

start.description: Acceleration out of the gate, begins compressed then stretches into stride.

fatigue.description: Slight slowdown variation with lower head and shorter stride.

finish.description: Finish-line crossing pose with extended neck and raised jockey posture.

usageNotes: Move the sprite horizontally in game code using server tick data; gallop/fatigue loops do not include horizontal translation.
Use anchor.x and groundY for lane alignment so entries can be swapped without vertical jumping.
Rows with fewer than 8 frames intentionally leave transparent cells at the end.
